title: Jet Fan for Makita Battery – Blow Clean Without a Cord
descriptionHtml:
The canned air runs out in the middle of the job

The dust in the computer, the shavings on the workbench, the leaves on the steps – the cans cost money and run dry, and the compressor with its hose is in a shed you're not in.

The turbo fan that clicks onto the battery you already have

A handheld jet fan with a brushless motor that blows away dust, shavings and leaves with a directed airflow. Pistol grip, trigger, and the base clicks straight onto the Makita 18V mount – the same battery as in your drill. Battery not included: it runs on the one you already own.

Features

  • Blows clean where the canned air ran out – dust, shavings and leaves with no consumables
  • Clicks straight onto the battery you own – fits the Makita 18V mount
  • Brushless motor in a pistol grip – aim it with one hand
  • Battery not included – the fan runs on your own tool battery

Change of mind

You have 14 days to change your mind, counted from the day you receive the item.
